DECLARE @cnt INT
DECLARE @udf VARCHAR(80)
DECLARE @combo VARCHAR(80)
BEGIN
SELECT @udf = obj_udfchar30, @combo = obj_code + '#' + obj_org FROM r5objects WHERE obj_sqlidentity=:ROWID
IF ( @udf is null )
DELETE FROM r5entityattributesets WHERE ese_rentity = 'EQRF' AND ese_entitycode = @combo
ELSE
BEGIN
SELECT @cnt = COUNT(*) FROM r5entityattributesets WHERE ese_rentity = 'EQRF' AND ese_entitycode = @combo
IF (@cnt <= 0)
INSERT INTO r5entityattributesets (ese_rentity, ese_entitycode, ese_attributesetdef, ese_name, ese_desc, ese_value1)
VALUES ('EQRF', @combo, 'S2XGLOBALID', @combo, @combo, @udf)
ELSE
UPDATE r5entityattributesets SET ese_value1 = @udf WHERE ese_rentity = 'EQRF' AND ese_entitycode = @combo AND ese_value1 != @udf
DELETE FROM r5entityattributesets WHERE ese_rentity = 'EQRF' AND ese_entitycode != @combo AND ese_value1 = @udf
END
END
